title: Verified web editor, preview and VS Code export
summary: Editor controls, actual preview interaction and saved project export passed tests. Current local teacher page is available.

changes.detail: Three file tabs, auto-saved browser draft, live iframe preview, phone width, console, explanation draft and VS Code local-copy export.
Supported teacher code blocks offer Edit and preview; prompts describe web preview capabilities.

validation.name: App checks
validation.detail: Learning app typecheck and focused ESLint passed.

validation.name: Preview and regression checks
validation.detail: 23 tests passed: actual HTML button clicks and JavaScript output in jsdom, file validation, teacher routes and change-history interactions/retention.

validation.name: Editor interaction
validation.detail: 1 jsdom test passed for tabs, iframe sandbox attribute, explanation draft and mocked VS Code export response.

validation.name: Actual file export
validation.detail: 1 test passed: complete three-file projects and README written to separate temporary directories, previous exports preserved and VS Code URI round-tripped.

validation.name: Live local routes
validation.detail: Teacher HTTP 200, unauthenticated workspace export 401, foreign origin 403.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: Full browser visual QA, browser CSP enforcement and desktop VS Code handoff not tested. Native editor unsupported. Export is a separate copy, not bidirectional sync. No deployment.
